caption: The image shows a color drawing of a decorative structure that appears to be a display or shrine-like case set atop a rectangular tan and yellow base with two ascending levels. The main structure features three visible glass panels, framed with green borders that have inner accents of yellow and pink geometric patterns at the bottom. At each corner where the glass panels meet, there are ornamental dark green leaf-like decorations. The top section of the structure is adorned with an elaborate pink decorative frieze containing imagery such as anchors, various vessels, and cornucopia, with shades of red, brown, and gray, and flanked by green foliage motifs on each side. The cornice above is decorated with a band made up of gold and white rectangular elements, and above this, a crest features more leaf and scroll motifs, also in green, with additional brown, gold, and yellow detailing. The entire drawing appears to be created with watercolor and ink, giving it a refined, illustrative look, and the background is plain and off-white.
title: Tabernacle
